presets.name: CLIENT
presets.label: Client
presets.description: App connected or stand alone messaging device.

presets.name: CLIENT_MUTE
presets.label: Client (mute)
presets.description: A client that never relays other nodes' packets.

presets.name: CLIENT_HIDDEN
presets.label: Client (hidden)
presets.description: Only speaks when spoken to: no routine broadcasts, relays known meshes only.

presets.name: CLIENT_BASE
presets.label: Client base
presets.description: Roof or attic node: relays traffic from and to its favorite nodes like a router.

presets.name: TAK
presets.label: TAK
presets.description: Connected to an ATAK device: CoT traffic, few routine broadcasts.

presets.name: ROUTER
presets.label: Router
presets.description: Infrastructure node on a tower or mountain top. Needs exceptional coverage.

presets.name: ROUTER_LATE
presets.label: Router (late)
presets.description: Infrastructure node that relays only after all others, to fill coverage gaps.

presets.name: TRACKER
presets.label: Tracker
presets.description: Broadcasts GPS position packets as priority.

presets.name: TAK_TRACKER
presets.label: TAK tracker
presets.description: Tracker that sends its position as TAK PLI.

presets.name: LOST_AND_FOUND
presets.label: Lost and found
presets.description: Broadcasts its position as a message every five minutes, to help recover the device.
